name: sequence-alignment
title: Sequence Alignment
description: Aligned DNA or protein sequences as rows of connected residue tiles: gaps as thin lines, blocks that wrap to the width (or one scrolling row under a draggable identity overview, names held), column ruler, end positions, a feature and marker track, identity bars, a consensus row, per-sequence identity and sorting, color by residue, conservation or difference (with dots), and block selection by drag, keyboard, names or ruler that copies as aligned FASTA; alignmentConsensus, percentIdentity, alignmentSlice and toFasta helpers.
